title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Floor Loading Table for Final Pay
content:
**Clause.** A Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service that sent 2 or more final pay payouts in the 3 months ending today, a window that takes in every payout dated fewer than 3 whole months before today, adds 10 percent to its replenishment floor, one that sent a single final pay payout in that window adds 5 percent, and any other service adds nothing for final pay. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's.

The kind of pay of each payout is read from the service's ledger; tips, off-cycle wages, bonuses and expense reimbursements are not final pay.

| Final pay payouts in the window | Loading |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10 percent |
| exactly 1 | 5 percent |
| none | nothing |

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates, today the 25th of a month)

A final pay payout dated the 26th of the month three calendar months earlier is in the window; one dated the 25th of that month is 3 whole months before today and is not.
